power.method: PoE (802.3at, Type 2, Class 4), max. 25.2W, or 12 VDC max. 22.8W / 24 VAC max. 22W

features: DeepinView deep-learning bullet with dedicated HEOP 2.0 AI Open Platform (5 TOPS, up to 3 loadable models)
DarkFighter 2.0 low-light imaging with 140 dB AWDR
multi-target-type detection — simultaneous face, human body and vehicle capture with feature extraction and license plate recognition
face capture (up to 120 faces/frame) and face comparison (150,000-face library)
multi-dimension people counting, regional people counting, queue management, heat map, on/off duty detection
perimeter protection: line crossing, intrusion, region entrance/exiting
PPE detection — hard hat and reflective clothing
ShotN technology for clear capture of humans and vehicles at speed
hybrid IR + white-light supplement, monitoring up to 100 m, 850 nm IR
10-50 mm motorized varifocal (P-iris) lens, EIS image stabilization
built-in heater, demist, G-sensor vibration detection and power meter

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.

release_notes: 8MP DarkFighter 2.0 DeepinView motorized-varifocal (P-iris, 10-50mm) bullet with HEOP 2.0 AI Open Platform, multi-target-type detection, face capture, people counting, heat map, PPE detection and perimeter protection; hybrid IR/white-light to 100m, 140 dB WDR, built-in heater. The /P variant adds ANPR/license-plate recognition and Wiegand. Specs verified against the official Hikvision datasheet iDS-2CD7A87G2H-XZHSY_Datasheet_20260820.
